fields.message: Edit the information of this Person

fields.label: Name
fields.name: cpt_person_name
fields.instructions: Enter the name of this Person. This is used on the front end, rather than the post title itself.

fields.label: Job Title
fields.name: cpt_person_job_title
fields.instructions: Enter the job title of this Person.

fields.label: Bio
fields.name: cpt_person_bio
fields.instructions: Enter the bio of this Person.

fields.label: Likes
fields.name: cpt_person_likes_repeater
fields.instructions: Enter the likes of this Person. These appear in the person modal on the front end.

cpt_person_like_key.label: Like
cpt_person_like_key.name: cpt_person_like
cpt_person_like_key.instructions: Enter a like of this Person.

fields.label: Dislikes
fields.name: cpt_person_dislikes_repeater
fields.instructions: Enter the dislikes of this Person. These appear in the person modal on the front end.

cpt_person_like_key.label: Dislike
cpt_person_like_key.name: cpt_person_dislike
cpt_person_like_key.instructions: Enter a dislike of this Person.

fields.label: Linkedin URL
fields.name: cpt_person_linkedin_url
fields.instructions: Enter this person's Linkedin profile URL, if applicable.

fields.label: Pronouns
fields.name: cpt_person_pronouns
fields.instructions: Add the pronouns of the selected user.

fields.label: Display Modal?
fields.name: cpt_person_display_modal
fields.instructions: Determines whether a modal with additional information can be displayed for this Person.

fields.label: Can be displayed randomly?
fields.name: cpt_person_can_be_displayed_randomly
fields.instructions: Determines whether this Person can be displayed randomly in the 'Let's Get Started' Block.

fields.message: Edit the images of this Person

fields.label: Profile Image
fields.name: cpt_person_profile_image
fields.instructions: Upload an image of this Person. This will be used on the front end for their 'Avatar' - eg on cards, or article byline. Use a square image for best results.

fields.label: Banner Image
fields.name: cpt_person_banner_image
fields.instructions: Upload an image to be used on the single banner page for this person. Please upload in aspect ratio 3:2.

fields.label: Fun Profile Image
fields.name: cpt_person_fun_profile_image
fields.instructions: Upload a 'fun' image of this Person. This will shown on the hoverstate of their 'Avatar' - eg on cards, or article byline. Use a square image for best results.

fields.label: Asterisk Image
fields.name: cpt_person_asterisk_image
fields.instructions: Upload an image of this Person. This will be used on the front end if they appear in the 'Let's Get Started' section of the site above the footer.

fields.label: Quote
fields.name: cpt_person_author_quote
fields.instructions: Enter the quote of this Person.
